scope: All six downloaded sources were visually reviewed in labeled contact sheets. This is sampled visual review, not continuous playback or physical-camera validation.
policy: Preserve originals; prepare only reviewed full-body single-person references. Multi-person, clipped-body, or low-resolution sources remain documented teaching material rather than silently becoming automatic pose references.

clips.title: Opening
clips.selectionReason: Title-card dissolve has cleared; the instructor is standing before the first opening step.

clips.title: Part the Wild Horse's Mane
clips.selectionReason: The opening press has reached the lower position; weight starts shifting for the first parting step.

clips.title: White Crane Spreads Its Wings
clips.selectionReason: The third parting stance settles and the rear foot begins gathering for the crane posture.

clips.title: Brush Knee and Push
clips.selectionReason: The crane posture settles; the elevated arm starts its circle for brush-knee preparation.

clips.title: Play the Lute
clips.selectionReason: The last brush-knee push settles; the rear foot begins its small gathering step.

clips.title: Repulse Monkey
clips.selectionReason: The lute posture settles; the rear arm opens for the first backward step.

clips.title: Grasp the Bird's Tail - Left
clips.selectionReason: The last backward push settles; the hands begin the left ward-off gathering motion.

clips.title: Grasp the Bird's Tail - Right
clips.selectionReason: The left sequence's final push settles; the torso begins turning toward the right sequence.

clips.title: Single Whip
clips.selectionReason: The right sequence's final push settles; both hands begin the long single-whip turn.

clips.title: Wave Hands Like Clouds
clips.selectionReason: The single-whip extension settles; weight shifts and the lower hand starts its cloud-hand circle.

clips.title: Single Whip Again
clips.selectionReason: The final cloud-hands gathering step settles; the hands begin forming the next single whip.

clips.title: High Pat on the Horse
clips.selectionReason: The second single-whip extension settles; the rear foot starts gathering for high pat.

clips.title: Right Heel Kick
clips.selectionReason: The high-pat reach settles; the arms begin crossing and opening for the right kick.

clips.title: Twin Fists Strike the Ears
clips.selectionReason: The right heel retracts from full extension; the arms begin lowering for the paired-fist step.

clips.title: Turn and Left Heel Kick
clips.selectionReason: The paired-fist strike settles; the torso starts turning for the left heel kick.

clips.title: Left Snake Creeps Down and Golden Rooster
clips.selectionReason: The left heel retracts; the leg begins lowering toward the first low sweeping stance.

clips.title: Right Snake Creeps Down and Golden Rooster
clips.selectionReason: The first one-leg posture settles; the lifted leg lowers into the opposite low stance.

clips.title: Work at Shuttles
clips.selectionReason: The second one-leg posture settles; the lifted leg begins the first diagonal shuttle step.

clips.title: Needle at the Sea Bottom
clips.selectionReason: The second shuttle push settles; the rear foot gathers before the low needle reach.

clips.title: Fan Through the Back
clips.selectionReason: The low needle reach is complete; the torso starts rising and the arms separate.

clips.title: Turn, Deflect, Parry, and Punch
clips.selectionReason: The fan-through-back extension settles; the body starts turning for deflect, parry, and punch.

clips.title: Apparent Close-Up
clips.selectionReason: The forward punch settles; the open hand moves under the punching forearm.

clips.title: Cross Hands
clips.selectionReason: The two-hand press settles; the body begins turning to the front for cross hands.

clips.title: Closing
clips.selectionReason: The crossed-hand posture settles; the hands begin to uncross before the closing press.

excludedRanges.reason: Completed routine hold and separate salute.

sources.exclusionReason: Two simultaneous bodies in the composite. The main-view rear foot reaches/passes the frame edge during the parting stance. A whole-frame single-person pose would be ambiguous. The inset would need separate orientation and edge auditing; no incomplete main-view clip is promoted.

clips.title: White Crane - Side View
clips.selectionReason: Begin before the instructor lowers from the initial held posture; retain the gathering step, weight transfer, arm separation, and completed crane posture. Exclude the long initial hold and the transition graphic at 24 seconds.

clips.title: White Crane - Back View
clips.selectionReason: Begin from the settled prior bow stance before the rear-foot gathering step; retain the complete slow demonstration and explanatory holds through the raised-hand finish. Exclude the previous scene and transition graphic.

excludedRanges.reason: Long finishing hold, transition graphic and initial hold of the next view.

sources.filename: 04_山东建筑大学_起势野马分鬃白鹤亮翅.mp4
sources.exclusionReason: 640x352 split-view lecture with variable close-ups, long explanatory holds, labels and screen overlays. A stable front-panel crop leaves roughly 130-180 pixels of body height. Use the matching clean source-front opening, wild-horse, and crane clips for automatic imitation.

sources.filename: 05_山东建筑大学_搂膝拗步手挥琵琶倒卷肱.mp4
sources.exclusionReason: 640x352 split-view instruction with variable close-ups, captions, screen overlays and long holds. The small panel is insufficient for a reliable primary reference. Use source-front forms 4-6; the source remains available for human study.

Composite rear view plus small front-view inset. The main instructor's extended hand approaches/overlaps the inset region in the left-facing sequence, so simply cropping off the inset would cut the main action. Mobile-player controls obscure the closing segment after about 335 seconds. Use the complete clean source-front routine for automatic imitation.
